checks.check: spec advertises the policy-pinned states VALID/SUSPENDED/REVOKED/UNVERIFIABLE/SUPERSEDED with no invented states; terminal REVOKED+SUPERSEDED; restoration path UNVERIFIABLE->SUSPENDED->VALID; closed revocation and supersession predicates
A: freshly issued certificate initial lifecycle state is VALID (virtual seq 0, adopted from the immutable issuance record; no transitions yet)
B: suspend VALID->SUSPENDED records a sequence-1 envelope-bound decision (previous VALID, next SUSPENDED, canon-v1 payload_hash recomputes; single sentence appended)
B: mark_unverifiable from VALID records UNVERIFIABLE (ANY->UNVERIFIABLE path; never destroys evidence)
B: evidence_recovered UNVERIFIABLE->SUSPENDED requires human authority kind (policy human_oversight (c)) and re-verified evidence
B: restore SUSPENDED->VALID requires a fully re-verified chain (lineage ACCEPT + bundle ACCEPT) and preserves the issuance; sequence 4
B: full path VALID->SUSPENDED->UNVERIFIABLE->SUSPENDED->VALID (sequences 1..4) is auditable via a reconstructable history
C: VALID->REVOKED forbidden — verb 'revoke' rejected with the P-CERTIFICATE-REVOCATION predicate cited; state untouched
C: VALID->SUPERSEDED forbidden — verb 'supersede' rejected (P-CERTIFICATE-SUPERSESSION); no successor ever created
D: undefined transitions (activate/expire/rotate_authority/garbage) fail closed
C/S: no revocation behavior exists anywhere (no revoke function exported; revocation_recorded event never produced)
T: no supersession behavior exists (no supersede/issue_successor functions; no successor is ever created in the issuance registry)
G: unauthorized or unregistered lifecycle authority fails closed (no peer/rotation can act)
G: authority kind mismatch fails closed
H: policy mismatch (wrong version / wrong policy / missing authority_doc) fails closed; policy file never reinterpreted
I: missing transition evidence fails closed
I: restoration without a re-verified chain (missing restoration) fails closed; mismatched bundle_id is not re-verified
I: restoration chain with a mismatched bundle_id fails closed
J: unknown certificate_id fails closed (identity must exist in the issuance registry)
K: an identical transition replay is recognized (matched by request_signature) and never duplicated; state and history unchanged
L: a conflicting transition under the current state fails closed (invalid_source_state) and preserves state/history
N/O: a persistence failure fails closed — ETS registry fully rolled back, history unchanged, issuance record untouched, zero partial traces
P: the issuance record stays byte-identical across all lifecycle transitions (identity, envelope, evidence_ids untouched)
Q: certificate_id is immutable across the history and never re-derived
R: restart replays the lifecycle ledger idempotently — authority, current state, and full history reconstruct
W: every lifecycle ledger sentence is canon-v1 canonical JSONL; every transition envelope recomputes its payload_hash under canon v1
V: no distributed lifecycle behavior exists — no distribute/sync/gossip/replicate functions; state is single-registry, predicate-local, and per-certificate locked
policy: evidence_recovered (UNVERIFIABLE resolution) is human-only — a mechanism-kind lifecycle authority is denied (authority_kind_denied); demonstrated by the 37-test suite
X: the full battery of invalid requests leaves the lifecycle state untouched (fail closed preserved across all rejection classes)
